g.text: Video helps, but learned probes do not beat the constant-distance baseline on average
Eight worlds equally weighted; seeds averaged within route direction, then route directions within world.
Constant = training-route mean pair distance; dashed line = constant baseline. Coordinate bar measures distance error, not coordinate error.
